title: Duplicate scan of printed page 126 (see scan 125)
headingPashto: د ۱۲۶ مخ دویم سکین (۱۲۵ سکین وګورئ)

paras.en: This is a second (duplicate) scan of printed page 126; its text is the same as scan 125. No new text has been taken from it.
paras.ur: یہ صفحہ، صفحہ نمبر 126 کا دوسرا (نقل) اسکین ہے جس کا متن اسکین 125 جیسا ہی ہے۔ اس میں سے کوئی نیا متن نہیں لیا گیا۔
paras.ps: دا د ۱۲۶ مخ دویم (نقل) سکین دی چې متن یې د ۱۲۵ سکین په څېر دی. له دې نه نوی متن نه دی اخیستل شوی.

sourceNote: Scan 127 (file 064_page_2) is a second scan of printed page 126, with the same text as scan 125; the page is slightly shifted (the left edge shows part of the next page). The words were compared with scan 125 and no differences were found, so no new text is entered. The page number at the top reads 126. English and Pashto are our translations (need native review); watermark, handwriting, page-edge shadows, a thumb at the page edge and ornamental borders excluded. Scan n = printed page n+1 up to scan 126; scans 127 and 128 are duplicates of scans 125 and 126 (the mapping to files then changes).
